title: Amphibian species affected by chytrid fungus: extinct vs still around (count)

source.name: Amphibian fungal panzootic causes catastrophic and ongoing loss of biodiversity (Scheele et al. 2019)

notes: Scheele et al. 2019 (Science) attribute declines in at least 501 amphibian species over roughly 50 years to chytridiomycosis, including 90 presumed extinctions. 501 - 90 = 411 declined-but-not-extinct.
